correctness.rationale: For the counting-measure combinatorial Laplacian, constants, leaf differences and the hub–leaf contrast have eigenvalues 0, 1 and m+1. Only distinct leaf pairs can be negative. Their common entry is [m−(m+1)e^(−at)+e^(−bt)]/[m(m+1)], where a=1+eta and b=(m+1)(1+(m+1)eta). Its derivative starts at −eta and has exactly one positive zero, while the entry tends to 1/(m+1); this proves the crossing and all boundary signs, including the identity at t=0. At the crossing let h=at. Eliminating b/a gives the delay [m(m+2)h+log(m+1−m e^h)]/[m(m+1)], with strictly negative second derivative. Its critical h=log((m+2)/(m+1)) lies in the permitted rate-ratio interval because m h<log(m+1)<m(m+2)h. Substitution and h~1/m verify the optimizer, the example and both growing-star limits. On two vertices L²=2L reduces the problem to ordinary heat. The analytic check is decisive; the packaged finite tests were reported, not rerun.
residual_risks: No extension to weighted, directed or normalized stars is tested or asserted.

evidence: Use N=m+1 and p=m/(m+1). The only nonedge class is distinct leaves, and its general within-part entry is precisely the frozen star entry. At the general optimum x*=log(m+2), the root relation gives e^(−(1+eta)t)=(m+1)/(m+2), so h=h_m and the rate ratio is x*/h_m=r_m. The broader optimized delay simplifies to the expression in the frozen Finding.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The implication includes uniqueness, the exact positivity set and both optimizer formulas. The star delay scaling is explicit in the broader theorem and the strength scaling follows by expanding h_m.

evidence: Daners–Glück–Kennedy give general eventual-positivity criteria; Gregorio–Mugnolo §6.1 treats eventual positivity for e^(−tL²). Neither yields the finite mixed-strength star optimizer under the same parameters.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Qualitative eventual positivity, pure biheat and finite-strength mixed semigroup positivity are different assertions; the mixed complete-multipartite formulation is the exact one.

value.rationale: Sharp recovery delays on stars are mathematically meaningful, but this record does not establish a distinct valuable remainder beyond the exact same-generator multipartite theorem.
